name: Kousoku Inran Jugyou Tokareta Ribbon
original_name: 拘束 淫爛授業 解かれたリボン
source:
Mayu is a female student who is in secret relationship with another girl Minako. One day Mayu opens her bento and finds there a photo of her tied up with a rope. It also has a note requesting to come to clerk room at noon or the photo would be made public.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
麻由是一名女学生，她与另一个女孩美奈子有秘密关系。有一天，麻友打开她的便当，发现里面有一张她被绳子绑着的照片。它还附有一张纸条，要求中午到职员室，否则照片将被公开。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
